BEFORE YOUR DETAIL

GOOD TO KNOW.

Something else on your mind?
Call (832) 466-1100

Do you come to my location?+

Yes, TLC is a mobile detailing service based in Bakersfield. Include your area when you ask for a quote so TLC can confirm service at your location.

What’s the difference between the packages?+

Quick Detail includes a surface wipe-down and vacuum, an exterior wash, and wheel-face cleaning. Extra TLC Full Detail adds deep interior cleaning, compressed-air crevice cleaning, more thorough wheel cleaning, and paint sealant for 6-month protection.

How do I get a price or appointment?+

Choose a package and share your vehicle and location by text, or call (832) 466-1100. TLC will confirm the price and availability with you. Opening a draft message does not reserve an appointment.

What if I’m not sure which detail I need?+

Select “Help me choose” below and describe what you’d like cleaned. You can add photos of your vehicle in your messaging app before you send your request.
